scope: Exact frozen B2 CPP/HPP against prior Bootstrap/config/native-binding/thread contracts; bounded static composition/lifetime review, not tests or full native equivalence.

findings.finding: BootstrapFacade derives only BootstrapConfiguration; no second ThreadBridge/BootstrapDependencies subobject.
Three inherited final configuration methods use prior startup/config source with the owned state and flags.
begin_thread routes through the existing05e8e0 source and rebuilt native Resolver, preserving security0/stack0/flags0 and outputID.
Detached-handle closure uses the same cached threads Effects provider.
Exit/terminate enums map to compiled rebuilt callback functions; unsupported selector values fail explicitly.
All remaining Services methods are mandatory forwarding policies; their native implementation/lifetime contracts remain open.
RuntimeOwner owns the configuration seed and three console flag bytes; it does not manufacture native initial globals.
Backend is uniquely owned and declared after state/flags so reverse destruction keeps referenced state alive during backend destruction.
providers() is called once during construction and the references are reused by one facade.
A missing provider owner fails before publishing or constructing a live binding.
bind_state receives the final owned state after all facade/bootstrap fields have initialized; its no-publication/no-workers contract is explicit.
publish is allowed only in Constructed; global binding publication happens after the RuntimeOwner constructor has completed.
Errors is an external borrowed process-lifetime policy and explicitly outlives post-close/post-destruction entry attempts, matching retained native last_errors.

source.anchor: // Permanent errors must outlive ALL future native-entry attempts

findings.finding: Copy and move are both disabled; published Bootstrap/dependency addresses remain stable.
Owner exposes application entry only in Bound phase and exposes no mutable facade/bootstrap getter.
stop_and_join must stop all admission and future callbacks, including pending/suspended workers; active_calls0 alone is insufficient.

source.anchor: // True promises all admission sources stopped

findings.finding: False/exception from stop_and_join leaves the backend, bootstrap and binding alive in Stopping for explicit retry; no implicit rollback/free.
Busy native Binding::close rejection likewise occurs before reset/Closed and retains the published owner.
After quiescence and successful native close, the optional binding resets before phase becomes Closed; repeated close is idempotent.
Busy control or Bound/Stopping destruction terminates rather than silently unpublishing or freeing resources whose pending callbacks may still exist.
A control scope rejects reentrant publish/close before changing the phase, preserves the outer busy flag on rejected nested construction, and clears the flag after false returns or exceptions.
This source supplies application-layer composition only: no PE entry, CRT initialization, double-CRT route,export body or native ABI completion is claimed.

source.anchor: // Application-layer composition only: no PE entry is installed

findings.finding: Compile-time checks require a nonabstract facade/owner, one unambiguous BootstrapDependencies conversion, and stable nonmovable owner.

source_role: New composition and lifecycle policy. Prior source-backed config/thread routing is reused; remaining mandatory policies are not relabeled as recovered bodies.
limits: No concrete OS/application ProviderOwner is supplied. providers/bind_state/quiescence contracts remain required from B3 and later source integration.
Services forwarding does not close its17 native policy implementations; worker pointers still need rebuilt worker/backend/global state owners.
stop_and_join must exclude late exit/terminate registration callbacks as well as worker callbacks. Without that concrete guarantee successful close is not established.
Control lifecycle calls belong to one serialized control thread; reentry is explicitly rejected. The control flag is not a cross-thread lock or synchronization mechanism.
Compiler/recovered CRT entry strategy, TLS/global startup, physical MSVC object ABI, exceptions/SEH and full DLL lifecycle remain open.
No native function body, existing typed native provider closure, original-image execution or DLL entry installation is added by this composition.
